scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs store prune && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @workspace/app run build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.build:all: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck:libs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
